A personalised, on-the-go solution that lets you seamlessly scroll, edit, organise, and directly stream a huge collection of stored photos and videos. * This Seagate BUP Slim Port External Hard Disk Drive image is for illustration purpose only. Personalise your look with a fun selection of colourful camouflage to choose from and enjoy all the performance and perks of the original.
